title: More than just great local craft beer!

After the behind-the-scenes tour, we went to 2 authentic and influential craft beer bars that we would not have found on our own. title: Exceeded all my expectations!
text: This tour was phenomenal!  I had signed up with the hope of visiting some cool bars and drinking some good beer.  While we certainly did that, the tour was so much more.  We met at BlackLab Brewhouse, where one of the proprietors, Matt showed us around the facility and explained their craft brewing process to us, relating how different ingredients would result in the different varieties of beer.  After a great beer there, we were off to CatBar.  On the way, Kiki showed us several historic buildings and explained their significance. title: Great tour and great beer
text: This was a highlight of my visit to Barcelona.  Kiki was great,  very personable and open to questions.  The tour started at BlackLab brewhouse and Matt, one of the proprietors gave us a detailed tour of the facility, explaining the process from start to finish. We had a beer there and then moved on to Cat Bar for another round.  On the way,  Kiki told us some history and pointed out some historic buildings. Finally, we went to Craft,  in a building that dates back to Roman times.  Another round of beer and live music.  I cannot recommend this tour highly enough.

title: Charming craft beer tour
